title: Unveiling Gender Bias in Large Language Models: Using Teacher’s Evaluation in Higher Education As an Example

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting GPT-4 to generate teacher evaluations using male and female instructor names and pronouns across various academic subjects, followed by evaluating the generated text using Odds Ratio (OR) analysis of salient adjectives, Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT), sentiment analysis, and contextual analysis.
